title: 2515. Shortest Distance to Target String in a Circular Array

examples.explanation: We start from index 1 and can reach "hello" by - moving 3 units to the right to reach index 4. - moving 2 units to the left to reach index 4. - moving 4 units to the right to reach index 0. - moving 1 unit to the left to reach index 0. The shortest distance to reach "hello" is 1.
We start from index 0 and can reach "leetcode" by - moving 2 units to the right to reach index 2. - moving 1 unit to the left to reach index 2. The shortest distance to reach "leetcode" is 1.
Since "ate" does not exist in words, we return -1.
